results.text: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic modeling of CYP2C8 substrate rosiglitazone and its metabolite to predict metabolic drug-drug interaction. Rosiglitazone is an activator of nuclear peroxisome proliferator-activated (PPAR) receptor gamma used in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus. The elimination of rosiglitazone occurs mainly via metabolism, with major contribution by enzyme cytochrome P450 (CYP) 2C8.
